data.narrative: Completed Module 8 deploy and verify - chose rolling deploy strategy (zero downtime, gradual replacement) and automated rollback (3 failures in 60 seconds triggers auto-revert). Implemented post-deploy verification: wait for /ready, smoke test against public URL, auto-rollback on failure. Fixed three production issues: business endpoint bug (added business smoke check), memory leak (added cache limit and memory metric), config drift (added audit log check). Deployment tagged with git SHA for traceability. Full deploy cycle verified.

dimension_scores.observation: Module 8 implements rolling deploy strategy for zero downtime with gradual replacement. Automated rollback (3 failures in 60 seconds) prevents cascading failures. Graceful degradation during deploy - if new version fails, only fraction of traffic hits it before detection. Memory leak fixed with cache limits to prevent gradual degradation.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Reflection summary: 'Deploying is not the finish line - verification is. You have not deployed until you prove with evidence that the new version is serving real traffic correctly'
Decision summary: 'Automated rollback monitors health checks after deploy and automatically reverts on failure (3 failures in 60 seconds). Works at 3 AM when nobody is watching'
Risk analysis: 'Service is healthy according to platform but broken for actual use. /ready passes because it only checks dependency connectivity, not memory usage or business logic'

learning_style_signals: values verification over trust in deployment
prioritizes automated safety nets over manual intervention
